4 ([[The Haunted Past]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]50 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3) |cash = {{Money|60}} upon death |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ghost ''' was the third enemy that appeared in the first and second acts of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had higher health and was faster than the [[Overgrowth (Lunar Overture)|Overgrowth]], but it was slower than the [[Pumpkid]]. It was also a hidden enemy, which means you need a tower with hidden detection to kill it. ==Appearance== The '''Ghost''' was a translucent green-white humanoid that floats slightly above the ground. It wore a tattered long-sleeve shirt that is the same color as its body. It also had a tail instead of legs, which moved as it floated on the path. ==Strategy== *Towers with cheap hidden detection such as the [[Warden]], [[Militant]], [[Golden Pyromancer]] or [[Golden Scout]] are recommended here. **If you have it, multiple [[Jester]]s can also work to deal with them. *Due to its high health, it is recommended to place more than one tower with hidden detection. ==Trivia== *Interestingly, despite being called a '''Ghost''', it is not a ghost-type enemy. ==Update History== *'''28 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]b **'''Ghost''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Ghost''' is difficult to select when trying to do so on its arms. *'''31 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]g **'''Ghost''' now appears in [[The Haunted Past]]. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Ghost''' removed. {{ADarkTale|[[Overgrowth (Lunar Overture)|Overgrowth]]|Wave 3|Ghost|Wave 5|[[Scarecrow (Lunar Overture)|Scarecrow]]|Wave 7}} {{TheHauntedPast|[[Skeleton (Lunar Overture)|Skeleton]]|Wave 2|Ghost|Wave 4|[[Mummy (Lunar Overture)|Mummy]]|Wave 5}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Ghost}}
